models_evaluated: deep learning model for ovarian tumor histologic subtype prediction from whole-slide images

links.outcome: Pathologist-rated interpretability and diagnostic usefulness of the model's explanations
links.effect: Human evaluation found explanations easy to interpret, rich in diagnostic features, and directly helpful for diagnostic decision-making; no numbers reported in the abstract.
links.quote: For interpretability and clinical utility in diagnostic contexts, human evaluation results showed that our explanations were easy to interpret, rich in diagnostic features, and directly helpful for diagnostic decision-making, thereby enhancing pathologist-AI collaboration.

links.outcome: Fidelity of explanations to the model's predictions and their clinical meaningfulness to pathologists
links.effect: Explanations accurately reflected the histomorphology underlying predictions at global and local levels, and pathologists rated them helpful; no numbers reported in the abstract.
links.quote: The results show that our framework generates explanations that accurately reflect the histomorphology underlying the model’s predictions at both global and local levels.

unlisted_practices: Human-in-the-loop explanation framework that combines global and local explanations grounded in expert-interpreted morphology

screen.reason: Evaluates MorphoXAI, an explainable AI framework added to a diagnostic DL model, assessing through human evaluation (pathologists) how explanations impact interpretability and diagnostic decision-making.

primary.practice: explainable AI / morphological explanations for clinician review
